primaries.name: CONSECRATE
intro: Each time a friendly unit destroys a unit, that friendly unit becomes a consecration unit. At the end of your turn, for each of your consecration units, you can select one objective it is within range of (excluding your home objective) that has not been consecrated. If you do, place one of your operation markers within range of that objective – that objective is consecrated and that unit is no longer a consecration unit.
